title: Regret updating
text:
Wish there was a way to keep or revert back to the old ui layout

Ui became more “modernized” with the update but it actually made pages bloated and less functional. All ui elements components increased in size and now there is less information readily available on the page without having to continuously scroll. Why would I want to see less information on an app meant to track a long list of transactions?!  

There’s some weird ui choices that were made. Dates are hard to see between huge transaction bubbles. Editing transactions does not have a save button displayed, only the x button to close it out, but that will save the edit. Adding a new transaction forcibly scrolls me away from where i left off. That is extremely frustrating since it’s already harder to scroll through the cluttered list to get to where I want. Afterwards, there is a brief popup to view the transaction added but the popup lasts for half a second before disappearing and clicking it only opens up that transaction, it doesn’t bring you to the placement on the list. Clicking on the tabs for a specific time period doesn’t stop the page from displaying other time periods upon scrolling. When I click the button for this months transactions on the home page, i DO NOT want to end up in last months transactions by accident especially with dates being harder to read now. 

On top of that, buttons and inputs are less responsive and actually lag pretty bad. I have to wait between every tap when entering the cost of items because the clicks don’t register fast enough. I’ve using this app for a while now but it’s so frustrating to use currently that I probably have to find an alternative.

title: What’s needed to make it truly usable
text: To effectively manage a budget, i have to be able to look at the budget DAILY and see that I am  on track. This is not feasible now because major purchases unnecessarily throw me off budget. For example, if I buy today a $5,000 family getaway including airline tickets and hotels, and the trip is scheduled to occur next year, I’d like to be able to spread the $5,000 across the specific days of the trip. Similarly, if I buy a sofa or a new iPhone, or a car(!). I now have this major purchase that unnecessarily throws me off my monthly, and possibly annual budget. If I could spread the expense across its lifetime, that problem goes away. This would enable me to look at the budget daily, and see how I’m doing. Specifically, what I need is: in the budget view the ability to set an accrual schedule for a transaction - when does it start, and across what period to spread it. This feature already exists for Cash transactions. All Spendee needs to do is enable this logic in the Budget view. So I spread the iPhone across, say, 4 years. And I spread the getaway package across 2 weeks, starting on the first day of my getaway.

title: Transaction issues
text:
I really want to love this app but I am having so many issues.  It has everything I am looking for: Ability to create my own budgets with the dates and frequencies I want.  The interface is easy to use.  But here is where I am stuck:

1.  Transactions not updating on a timely fashion. 
2. When the transactions do update, it reclassified some of the transactions it updated before.  This messes up my budgets because it moves items out of the buckets I have moved them to.  
3. The dates on my transactions is a day before.  Example, if I make a purchase 12/20 with my credit card, once that transaction appears on Spendee, it shows as 12/19.  Is almost as if the app itself has the wrong date.

title: Missing key features
text: Two things most people need in a personal finance app are “how much do I have until my next payday” and “what do I have right now”. This platform gives you neither. I really wanted to like it, even was prepared to pay for premium but it didn’t meet my basic needs. It gives you some sort of net worth calculation that I could never back into. Finally it did not have my main bank in the us but have the uk version. Sorry but this just didn’t do anything for me but waste my time.
